title: France reports Ebola case in doctor returning from Congo
summary: A doctor who recently returned ​to France from a humanitarian mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola, marking the country's ​first confirmed ‌case linked to the current ⁠outbreak, the health ministry said on Wednesday.
